name: smartflow-beta
description: WESEO SmartFlow: the complete WordPress/WST workflow in one plugin, from server-side WST Section and Custom Post Type foundations to local frontend CSS and Playwright QA. Successor to the wst-builder, frontend-design-qa, and wordpress-server-ops plugins; do not run it next to any of them. Beta channel: pre-release build for WESEO frontend beta testers; do not use in production.
